Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 3.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1162
Claimant:
William Lyons
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
06/13/2023
First notice of loss received by phone from the claimant, who reports a low-speed head-on collision at a residential
intersection earlier today. The claimant states they were the driver of the insured vehicle and complains of neck pain.
06/30/2023
Recorded a detailed statement from the claimant, who described the sequence of events and the approach of the
other vehicle in the same way as in the first call. Confirmed the claimant was seated in the driver's seat at the time of
impact.
08/18/2023
Spoke with the other driver, who independently confirmed the vehicles collided head-on at low speed and that the
claimant was behind the wheel. Their account matches the claimant's description of the collision.
09/23/2023
Reviewed the police report, which lists the claimant as a vehicle occupant and records the same location, time of
impact, and direction of travel. Report notes no citations were issued.
10/25/2023
Obtained scene photographs and two witness statements. Both witnesses describe a minor impact consistent with
what the claimant and the other driver reported.
11/05/2023
Insepcted the insured vehicle. Front-end dmaage is consistent with the reported impact. A few old scratches on the
lower bumper may predate this loss and have been noted separately for the repair estimate.
11/22/2023
Confirmed with the policy records that coverage was in force on the date of loss and that no prior claims or damage
reports exist for this vehicle. Nothing in the file suggests damage occurred before coverage began.
12/08/2023
Verified that the claimant is a household member of the policyholder and lives at the same address, so they qualify as
a covered driver under the policy.
12/14/2023
Claimant has reported neck stiffness and headaches to the treating provider. The provider's notes indicate a
whiplash-type injury, which is a plausible result of a collision of this kind. No prior treatment to the neck or upper back
appears in the records available.
12/28/2023
Treatment has followed a typical course of physical therapy and medication. Claimant reports steady improvement,
and the frequency of visits has decreased as recovery progressed.
01/05/2024
Called the claimant for a status update. Claimant repeated the same account of the accident and the symptoms, with
no changes to the timeline or the injuries described earlier.
01/11/2024
Reviewed the file as of today. Liability and coverage are confirmed, the injury appears consistent with the collision,
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
